name: ct_abdomen
description: Order a CT abdomen to evaluate abdominal organs, vasculature, and retroperitoneum. Contrast-enhanced for solid organ pathology; non-contrast for renal stones.

oral_contrast.description: Whether oral contrast is needed for bowel evaluation

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., abdominal pain, mass, trauma)

when_to_use: acute abdominal pain with diagnostic uncertainty (CT with IV contrast)
blunt abdominal trauma (FAST-positive or hemodynamically unstable)
suspected renal or ureteral calculi (non-contrast CT)

examples.query: Right lower quadrant pain, fever, elevated WBC
Sudden onset left flank pain radiating to groin, hematuria
